instruction: Add 'aolusername@aol.com' as an AOL account in Thunderbird with the password 'aolsecure789', and ensure the setup is completed regardless of any connection or login issues.

metadata.explanation: Variation 2: AOL email account setup task. User must configure both IMAP (imap.aol.com) and SMTP (smtp.aol.com) servers with credentials aolusername@aol.com / aolsecure789. Evaluator uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract saved account credentials from Thunderbird profile and validates both incoming and outgoing mail server configurations are present. Same complexity as original task - requires multi-step account setup with both IMAP and SMTP configuration.
metadata.verification: Task validated against Thunderbird account setup process. AOL uses standard IMAP (imap.aol.com) and SMTP (smtp.aol.com) servers. The check_csv metric will verify both mail server entries exist with correct credentials.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if both IMAP and SMTP accounts are configured correctly with specified credentials, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract saved credentials from Thunderbird profile - this is the standard approach for verifying Thunderbird account configuration
Complete coverage: verifies both IMAP (imap://imap.aol.com) and SMTP (smtp://smtp.aol.com) accounts are configured with correct credentials
Expected values are semantically correct - AOL does use these standard server URLs and the credentials match the instruction exactly
Postconfig properly downloads the decryption tool and executes it with correct parameters (CSV format output to thunderbird-accounts.csv)
Data flow is correct: postconfig extracts credentials → result getter retrieves CSV → check_csv metric validates both account entries exist
check_csv metric logic correctly checks that all expected records are present and matches them against CSV rows using _match_record helper
